title: File Copy Re H.V. Muehlhauser

page_data.en:
File COPY
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. RECORDS
No. S. B. D. 2351.
c/e 11 - 5 - 31.
Special Branch S. 2.
May 9, 1931.

H. V. Muehlhauser.

H.V. Muehlhauser has resided in Shanghai for about eight years. Four or five years ago he had a small motor repair shop at No. 32 Markham Road, afterwards removing to his present address, No. 26 Yu Yuen Road. He is regarded as a capable workman but is addicted to drink, and when in possession of money he invariably spends it on drink and neglects his work. Muehlhauser is considered a respectable person apart from this failing, who otherwise would have been able to build up a good business of his own.

On December 12, 1926 he was arrested on Hardoon Road for being drunk in charge of a motor car and was fined $70 at the Mixed Court.

Should it be considered necessary, further enquiries can be made regarding his earlier history.

Sgd:- W. DUNCAN.
D. S. I.

N.B.
File out 6:-
D.C. (Immigration)
4/5.

档案副本
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉与情报记录
编号 S. B. D. 2351。
抄送日期 31年5月11日。
特别分部 S. 2。
1931年5月9日。

H. V. Muehlhauser（音译）。

H.V. Muehlhauser（音译）在上海居住约八年。四五年前，他在马格纳路（Markham Road）32号经营一家小型汽车修理铺，后迁至现址，即愚园路26号。他被视为一名能干的技工，但嗜酒成性，一旦手头有钱，便 invariably 用于饮酒而荒废工作。除这一缺点外，Muehlhauser（音译）被认为是一位体面人士，否则本应能够建立起良好的个人事业。

1926年12月12日，他因醉酒驾驶汽车在哈同路（Hardoon Road）被捕，并被会审公廨罚款70元。

如有必要，可对其早期经历作进一步调查。

签署：W. DUNCAN。
副督察长。

注：
档案借出 6:-
DC（移民科）
